request:
Which classes name JupyterMixin (from rich/jupyter.py) directly as a base class but do not define their own __rich_measure__ method in their class body? Give each class's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds classes whose base list includes JupyterMixin directly, then excludes any class that has a __rich_measure__ method symbol located within the class's own line range (i.e., defined in its class body). Returns the distinct class symbol IDs that inherit the mixin without overriding __rich_measure__.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_name = 'JupyterMixin' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.file_id = (SELECT s2.file_id FROM code.symbols s2 WHERE s2.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id) AND s.name = '__rich_measure__' AND s.kind = 'method' AND s.line_start >= (SELECT s3.line_start FROM code.symbols s3 WHERE s3.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id) AND s.line_end <= (SELECT s4.line_end FROM code.symbols s4 WHERE s4.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id))
